#!/usr/bin/env bash
# jusshin — register self-hosted GitHub Actions runners as launchd agents.
# rendered by nen 0.0.0-test runner script — do not edit; re-run nen runner script
#
# target:   zheref/nen
# pool:     macos-arm64 (self-hosted,macOS,ARM64)
# runners:  NZ-NNR1, NZ-NNR2, NZ-NNR3
# identity: invoking-user
# root:     /Users/runner-host/actions-runners
# package:  actions-runner-osx-arm64-2.337.0.tar.gz (runner 2.337.0)
#
# Run it as YOURSELF, not with sudo: bash <this file>. A macOS runner is a
# LaunchAgent of the user who installs it. The registration token is minted
# per runner into a variable that is never printed, and reaches config.sh
# through its environment, never argv. Keep this file outside the runner root
# (e.g. ~/.local/state/nen/jusshin/).
#
# Exit codes: 0 every planned runner's service is running; 1 anything else;
# 3 run as the wrong user; 5 gh missing or not signed in; 6 the runner
# package failed its SHA-256 check (the file is deleted). The one summary
# line is also written to $PROJECT_DIR/_jusshin/register-<ts>.summary.
set -euo pipefail

TARGET='zheref/nen'
REPO_URL='https://github.com/zheref/nen'
LABELS='self-hosted,macOS,ARM64'
ROOT='/Users/runner-host/actions-runners'
PROJECT_DIR='/Users/runner-host/actions-runners/nen-runners'
DOWNLOAD_URL='https://github.com/actions/runner/releases/download/v2.337.0/actions-runner-osx-arm64-2.337.0.tar.gz'
ARCHIVE='actions-runner-osx-arm64-2.337.0.tar.gz'
SHA256='5a2cd92908a93d7276a194e1de6008099f3e7946f3f8e14aa7a1a7b4a31fdec2'
SERVICE_PREFIX='actions.runner.zheref-nen.'
RUNNERS=(
  'NZ-NNR1|/Users/runner-host/actions-runners/nen-runners/Runner1'
  'NZ-NNR2|/Users/runner-host/actions-runners/nen-runners/Runner2'
  'NZ-NNR3|/Users/runner-host/actions-runners/nen-runners/Runner3'
)
WORK_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/_jusshin"
registered=0
skipped=0
failed=0
stamp="$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
summary_file=""

# The summary file carries the ONE summary line and nothing else: it is what
# the caller reads. The log is the maintainer's.
finish() {
  summary="jusshin: ${registered} registered, ${skipped} skipped, ${failed} failed"
  echo "$summary"
  if [ -n "$summary_file" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$summary" > "$summary_file" || true; fi
  exit "$1"
}

# Whether a runner directory is already configured as NAME (idempotent re-run).
configured_as() {
  [ -f "$1/.runner" ] && grep -q "\"agentName\": *\"$2\"" "$1/.runner"
}

# Why a directory configured as NAME is stale, or nothing when it stands: its
# service is absent ($2 is not 1), or GitHub no longer lists its registration
# ($3, one name per line) (#319).
stale_reason() {
  local reasons=""
  if [ "$2" != 1 ]; then reasons="its service is absent"; fi
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$3" | grep -Fxq -- "$1"; then
    reasons="${reasons:+$reasons and }GitHub no longer lists its registration"
  fi
  printf '%s' "$reasons"
}

# The names GitHub lists for the repository's runners, read once into
# $listed; $listed_ok is 1 when the read succeeded.
listed=""
listed_ok=""
read_listed() {
  if [ -n "$listed_ok" ]; then return 0; fi
  if listed="$(gh_run api --paginate "repos/$TARGET/actions/runners" --jq '.runners[].name' 2>/dev/null)"; then listed_ok=1; else listed_ok=0; fi
}

# Stop and uninstall a stale runner's service from its own directory.
remove_service() {
  (cd "$1" && { ./svc.sh stop || true; } && ./svc.sh uninstall)
}

if [ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "jusshin: run as yourself, not root -- a macOS runner is a LaunchAgent of the user who installs it."
  finish 3
fi
gh_run() { gh "$@"; }
service_present() { [ -f "$HOME/Library/LaunchAgents/${SERVICE_PREFIX}$1.plist" ]; }
if ! gh --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "jusshin: gh is not on PATH. Install the GitHub CLI and re-run."
  finish 5
fi
if ! gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "jusshin: 'gh auth status' failed. Run 'gh auth login' and re-run."
  finish 5
fi

mkdir -p "$ROOT" "$PROJECT_DIR" "$WORK_DIR"
log="$WORK_DIR/register-$stamp.log"
summary_file="$WORK_DIR/register-$stamp.summary"
exec > >(tee -a "$log") 2>&1
echo "jusshin: ${#RUNNERS[@]} runner(s) for $TARGET; log $log"

pending=()
replace_names=" "
for entry in "${RUNNERS[@]}"; do
  name="${entry%%|*}"
  dir="${entry#*|}"
  if configured_as "$dir" "$name"; then
    # Configured is not standing (#319): a failed service install leaves .runner
    # behind with no service, and a removed registration leaves one GitHub no
    # longer lists. Either is stale -- emptied and re-registered, never skipped.
    read_listed
    if [ "$listed_ok" != 1 ]; then
      echo "jusshin: could not list the runners of $TARGET, so $name in $dir cannot be told live from stale -- left untouched."
      failed=$((failed + 1))
      continue
    fi
    has_service=0
    if service_present "$name"; then has_service=1; fi
    reason="$(stale_reason "$name" "$has_service" "$listed")"
    if [ -z "$reason" ]; then
      echo "jusshin: $name is already configured in $dir -- skipped."
      skipped=$((skipped + 1))
      continue
    fi
    echo "jusshin: $name in $dir is stale ($reason) -- emptied and re-registered."
    if [ "$has_service" = 1 ] && ! remove_service "$dir"; then
      echo "jusshin: svc.sh could not uninstall the stale service for $name; $dir left untouched."
      failed=$((failed + 1))
      continue
    fi
    rm -rf "$dir"
    # A stale runner GitHub still lists is replaced under its own name.
    if printf '%s\n' "$listed" | grep -Fxq -- "$name"; then replace_names="$replace_names$name "; fi
    pending+=("$entry")
    continue
  fi
  if [ -f "$dir/.runner" ]; then
    echo "jusshin: $dir holds a runner configured as another name, not $name -- left untouched."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  pending+=("$entry")
done

archive="$WORK_DIR/$ARCHIVE"
verify_archive() {
  echo "$SHA256  $archive" | shasum -a 256 -c - >/dev/null 2>&1
}
if [ "${#pending[@]}" -gt 0 ]; then
  if [ ! -f "$archive" ] || ! verify_archive; then
    echo "jusshin: downloading $ARCHIVE"
    curl -fsSL -o "$archive" "$DOWNLOAD_URL"
    if ! verify_archive; then
      rm -f "$archive"
      echo "jusshin: $ARCHIVE failed its SHA-256 check (expected $SHA256) -- deleted."
      finish 6
    fi
  fi
  echo "jusshin: $ARCHIVE verified (sha256 $SHA256)."
fi

for entry in "${pending[@]+"${pending[@]}"}"; do
  name="${entry%%|*}"
  dir="${entry#*|}"
  echo "jusshin: registering $name in $dir"
  mkdir -p "$dir"
  # Re-hashed immediately before EVERY extraction, not only after the download.
  if ! verify_archive; then
    rm -f "$archive"
    echo "jusshin: $ARCHIVE no longer matches sha256 $SHA256 -- deleted; nothing extracted into $dir."
    finish 6
  fi
  tar xzf "$archive" -C "$dir"
  token="$(gh api -X POST "repos/$TARGET/actions/runners/registration-token" --jq .token 2>/dev/null)" || token=""
  if [ -z "$token" ]; then
    echo "jusshin: could not mint a registration token for $name; the gh user must be an admin of $TARGET."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  # NO TOKEN ON A COMMAND LINE: it reaches config.sh as ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_TOKEN,
  # which actions/runner reads as its --token input; a prefix assignment is
  # never part of argv.
  replace=()
  case "$replace_names" in *" $name "*) replace=(--replace) ;; esac
  if ! (cd "$dir" && ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_TOKEN="$token" ./config.sh --unattended --url "$REPO_URL" --name "$name" --labels "$LABELS" --work _work ${replace[@]+"${replace[@]}"}); then
    token=""
    echo "jusshin: config.sh failed for $name."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  token=""
  if ! (cd "$dir" && ./svc.sh install && ./svc.sh start); then
    echo "jusshin: svc.sh could not install or start the LaunchAgent for $name."
    failed=$((failed + 1))
    continue
  fi
  registered=$((registered + 1))
done

# Background Task Management: a LaunchAgent macOS has not approved is loaded
# with no PID ('-' in launchctl list). It is held pending approval under
# System Settings > General > Login Items; this script never approves it.
down=0
for entry in "${RUNNERS[@]}"; do
  name="${entry%%|*}"
  label="${SERVICE_PREFIX}${name}"
  launchctl print "gui/$(id -u)/$label" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^[[:space:]]*(state|pid) =" || true
  pid="$(launchctl list | while read -r p _ l; do if [ "$l" = "$label" ]; then echo "$p"; fi; done)"
  if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ "$pid" = "-" ]; then
    echo "jusshin: $label has no PID -- if it is listed, it is held pending approval under System Settings > General > Login Items (approve it there; nen never does)."
    down=$((down + 1))
  fi
done

if [ "$down" -eq 0 ] && [ "$failed" -eq 0 ]; then finish 0; fi
finish 1
